result.instructions: Tools for Aurora Solar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my newest Aurora projects and their status."; "Show the system size, price per watt and financing options of the latest design on the Miller project."; "Which design requests are still waiting for an answer?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Aurora Solar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run aurora_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aurora_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aurora_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. aurora_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aurora_get_tenant
tools.title: Get the tenant
tools.description: Get metadata about your Aurora tenant: name, status, address, currency, units and the list of project statuses. Good first call. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}.

tools.name: aurora_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users of the tenant. Optional filters by email, external provider id or partner id. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/users.

email.description: Only users with one of these emails.

external_provider_id.description: Only users with one of these external provider ids.

partner_id.description: Only users of one of these partners.

tools.name: aurora_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams of the tenant, sorted by name (Grow and Scale plans only). GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/teams.

tools.name: aurora_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects, newest first: id, name, created_at, property_address and tags. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects.

tools.name: aurora_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id: customer details, address, status, owner and team. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{id}.

tools.name: aurora_get_project_note
tools.title: Get the project note
tools.description: Get the free-text note of a project. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/project_note.

tools.name: aurora_get_consumption_profile
tools.title: Get the consumption profile
tools.description: Get the energy consumption profile of a project: utility, rate, monthly energy and bills. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{id}/consumption_profile.

tools.name: aurora_get_project_bill_summary
tools.title: Get the project bill summary
tools.description: Get the estimated year-1 utility bill summary of a project before solar. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{id}/bill_summary.

tools.name: aurora_list_agreements
tools.title: List agreements
tools.description: List the sales agreements of a project, newest first. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/agreements.

tools.name: aurora_get_ahj
tools.title: Get an AHJ
tools.description: Get an Authority Having Jurisdiction (permit office) with its general and structural requirements. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/ahjs/{id}.

tools.name: aurora_list_designs
tools.title: List designs of a project
tools.description: List the designs of one project. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{id}/designs.

tools.name: aurora_get_design
tools.title: Get a design
tools.description: Get one design: name, project, milestone, imagery and lidar source. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{id}.

tools.name: aurora_get_design_summary
tools.title: Get a design summary
tools.description: Get the design summary: system sizes, bill of materials, arrays, inverters, batteries and energy production. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{id}/summary.

tools.name: aurora_get_roof_summary
tools.title: Get a roof summary
tools.description: Get the summary of all roofs of a design. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{design_id}/roof_summary.

tools.name: aurora_get_design_pricing
tools.title: Get design pricing
tools.description: Get the pricing of a design: method, price per watt, adders, incentives and breakdown. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{id}/pricing.

tools.name: aurora_get_design_bill_summary
tools.title: Get the design bill summary
tools.description: Get the estimated year-1 utility bill summary of a design with solar. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{id}/bill_summary.

tools.name: aurora_list_financings
tools.title: List financings
tools.description: List the financing options of a design (cash, loan, lease, PPA). GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{design_id}/financings.

selected_in_sales_mode.description: Only the financing selected in Sales Mode.

tools.name: aurora_list_design_assets
tools.title: List design assets
tools.description: List the files of a design (screenshots, DXF, racking documents) with download links. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{design_id}/assets.

asset_type.description: Only these asset types, e.g. 'Design DXF', 'CAD Screenshot'.

tools.name: aurora_get_web_proposal
tools.title: Get the web proposal link
tools.description: Get the customer-facing Web Proposal URL of a design and whether it expired. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/designs/{design_id}/web_proposal.

tools.name: aurora_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List leads (orders) of the tenant, newest first. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/orders.

tools.name: aurora_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order: customer contact, address, phase, seller and notes. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/orders/{id}.

tools.name: aurora_list_design_requests
tools.title: List design requests
tools.description: List design requests, newest first, optionally by status. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/design_requests.

tools.name: aurora_list_modules
tools.title: List solar modules
tools.description: List the solar modules enabled for the tenant. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/components/modules.

tools.name: aurora_list_inverters
tools.title: List inverters
tools.description: List the inverters enabled for the tenant. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/components/inverters.

tools.name: aurora_list_proposal_templates
tools.title: List proposal templates
tools.description: List proposal templates, optionally only enabled or default ones. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/proposal_templates.

tools.name: aurora_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of the tenant. GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: aurora_update_project
tools.title: Update a project
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing project (name, status, customer contact, mailing address). Only the fields you pass change. Use aurora_get_tenant to see valid statuses. PUT /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{id}.

status.description: New status (one of the tenant's project statuses).

mailing_address.description: Homeowner mailing address (not the site address).

tools.name: aurora_update_project_note
tools.title: Update the project note
tools.description: WRITE: replace the content of a project's note with the given text (the old text is overwritten; read it first with aurora_get_project_note). PUT /tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/project_note.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Aurora Solar
prompts.description: What you can do with Aurora Solar here, with example requests to try.
